title: Grothendieck Rings of Module Categories: Localizations, Strata, and Radicals
summary: For a non-degenerate braided fusion category $\mathcal B$, we study the Grothendieck $\mathbb Z_+$-ring of $\mathcal B$-module categories. We define a convolution of étale algebras in the Drinfeld center $\mathcal Z(\mathcal B)$ and show that the full center of a relative tensor product of module categories is canonically isomorphic to the convolution of their full centers. The module Grothendieck ring has a canonical upper-triangular grading by the poset of localizations of $\mathcal B$. We describe each localization stratum by double-coset endpoint blocks and a group-ring-valued transition…
